name: Therion
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished vertical character illustration for a Kalistar x Octopath Traveler personal art proposal. Illustration ONLY, NO card frame, text, watermark, logos, UI, collage or contact sheet.
REFERENCE ROLES: the supplied Momo and Valazar images are PAINTERLY STYLE references ONLY. Do not copy their characters, hats, skeletons, ruins, poses or background. Strict Kalistar art direction: richly layered narrative fantasy digital PAINTING, confident visible brush planes, sculpted painted anatomy, selective worn fabric/leather/metal textures, hierarchical lost-and-found edges, cinematic motivated warm/cool light. NOT photograph, not glossy 3D, anime/manga, cel shaded, pixel art or uniformly grainy filter. Preserve the named Octopath character's recognizable original base-job outfit, hairstyle, age and signature equipment; do not turn everyone into generic armored fantasy soldiers. Adapt the rendering to Kalistar rather than copying the Octopath watercolor or pixel rendering.
Portrait aspect ratio approximately 4:5, spacious medium-full composition for a future 737:921 artwork window. Head, meaningful gesture and hands comfortably readable centrally. Anatomically coherent neck/shoulders/elbows/wrists/legs; exactly two arms, no doubled hands or fingers. Show natural body length, never compress or bend a weapon to fit; allow a tip, cloth or secondary object to leave the image naturally. Believable contact/grips, continuous straight rigid shafts/blades apart from intended weapon curvature. One strong narrative action and readable personal emotion. Character dominant; background only 2-3 broad painterly masses, softly resolved, no busy ruins, crowds, filigree clutter or particle storm. Each scene should feel caught in life, not a mannequin posing. Faithful costume colours with restrained atmospheric contrast, not monochrome sepia.
CHARACTER AND SCENE:
THERION, the adult thief from Octopath Traveler I, recognizable short messy silver-gray hair, narrow watchful eyes, burgundy scarf partly covering neck, dark practical leather travel clothing and his restrictive metal wrist bangle visible. Standing against the inner side of a quiet stone arch after a heist, body angled away but head turns back sharply over shoulder, guarded distrust. Left hand near chest hides one small luminous green Dragonstone under curled fingers, right hand holds one slender straight dagger low beside thigh, coherent blade and grip. Do not hide arms behind the torso ambiguously; both arm paths readable. Cropped below knees, silhouette long and lean, scarf trails naturally. Broad midnight blue wall, single warm distant window reflected on rain-dark pavement, no city vista, guards or debris. Restrained green reflection on palm, no VFX storm.
FACIAL RENDERING PRIORITY: fully painted natural human facial anatomy with normal-sized eyes, adult bone structure where adult, real eyelids, natural nose and lips, subtle asymmetry and tangible sculpted planes. No oversized anime eyes, porcelain doll skin, tiny anime nose or generic pretty manga face. Brushwork should structure form rather than look like gold-speckled damage covering every surface. Background remain broad and quiet.
